english.title: Sporting events - possess alcohol on motor vehicle

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: SPORTING EVENTS CONTROL OF ALCOHOL ETC ACT 1985

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession intoxicating liquor on a motor vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers and which was being used for the principal purpose of carrying two or more passengers for the whole or part of a journey to or from a designated sporting event namely **(..SPECIFY SPORTING EVENT..).
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1A(3) and 8 of the Sporting Events (Control of Alcohol etc) Act 1985.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Consider an application for an exclusion order from 'prescribed football matches'

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A constable may search a person he has reasonable grounds to suspect is committing or has committed an offence under this Act, and may arrest such a person. (section 7(2)).
(ii) A constable may stop a motor vehicle, if he has reasonable grounds to suspect that an offence under this section is being or has been committed in respect of the vehicle. (section 7(3)).
(iii) See also offence wording H2187 re coaches and trains.

other.powersofarrest: A constable may search a person he has reasonable grounds to suspect is committing or has committed an offence under this Act, and may arrest such a person. (section 7(2)).
other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
